content: Judá-yar, Rey-Senaqueribʼgi ollorgusad
Rey-Ezequías deyob ega ibmar-soge itosgua, e-mor-yoid na siir-siir imaksad. Geb wile-itoged-mor yosad, degi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse geb naded.

Degine, Rey-Ezequías, e-neg-dakdiid-Eliaquim, degi, ibmar-gusmalad-narmaked-Sebna, degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-sergan, wile-itoged-mor yoyoi, Amoz-machi-Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaíasʼse barmisad, adi, daknamalagar.

Amar ega sogdapmalad: “Weyob Rey-Ezequías soged: ‘Emi-iba-naidi, suli-suli-itoleged-iba naid, sabsur-odurdakleged-iba naid, degine, bingeguleged-iba naid. Ar igi sikwi we-napnegse-aidesokalile, na ome e-abagan-nolloo naddae, deyob emi-iba naid.

Bitigine, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, Asiria-sorda-daked-dummad-e-ibmar-sogsadi bela itosana gadin. Ar ade, e-dummad-Asiria-e-rey, Bab-Dummad-Dula-Maidgi dodoar-sunmakega barmiar gusad. Bitigine, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, we-dule-gayaburba-itosadba sabsur-odurdaksunnana gadin. Emide, Israel-dulemar-napi-gudimaladga be Bab-Dummadse gorsun.’ ”
Rey-Ezequíasʼga-arbamalad Isaías-dakapmargu,
Isaías ega sogsa gusad: “Weyob be-dummad-Ezequíasʼga be sogmalo: ‘Bab-Jehová weyob sogye: Be, Asiria-rey-e-maigan e-ibmar-soge-itosadgine, nue angi ise-yolegar sunmaksadgine, mer-be gwayo.
Ani, an Senaqueribʼse gayaburba-isgana-warmakega an imakoed, adi, gannar e-yarse naegar. Geb agine es-suidgi oburgwemalaga an imakoed.’ ”
Asiria-sorda-idued-e-dummad, Asiria-e-rey Laquis-neggweburgi-mai nadye wisguargu, balimakde gusad. Agine, Asiria-e-rey, Libna-neggweburgi bila-ononai dakdapid.
Geb agine, Rey-Senaquerib wisgualid, Etiopía-dulemar-e-rey-Tirhaca, ebo bila-onogega egi daniye. Geb gannar Rey-Ezequíasʼse dule-gayaburba-berbemalad barmisad.
Adi, ega sogega: “Judá-e-rey-Ezequías: ‘Be, mer be be-Bab-Dummadgi-bensulidse be yamolego, ar bega sokalir: Asiria-e-rey Jerusalén-neggwebur-suosurye.
Ar be Asiria-e-reymar yarmar nue obelodii-gusadi nue-itodiid. Degite, ¿Ar bedi unni-san-onogo na be itosi?
Ar an-babgan,
Ezequías, Bab-Dummadse-gochad
Degine, Ezequías, dule-gayaburba-berbemalad-abin garda susad, geb absosad. Geb a-sorbali, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse-naded. Agine Bab-Jehová-asabin garda nallaa imaksad.

Geb degi, Ezequías, Bab-Jehováʼse goted: “Bab-Jehováʼye Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummadye, baliwiturmar-wagar-darbakegwad-abargi be negsemaid. Bebi unnila we napaneg-naid e-Bab-Dummadga gued. Be nibneg, degine, napneg, be nasiksad.
Bab-Jehová nue wis be an-itoge. An-ibmar-soged be wis-itoge. Be anmargi ibmar-gunaid nue be dake. Senaquerib begi ise-gwisguar anga gayaburba-barmialidi, nue be itoge.
”Bab-Jehováʼye, ar nabirid, Asiria-e-reymar we-yarmar, degi, e-napamar bela obelos gusad.

E-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad bela soogi ogumaksa gusmalad. Ar ade, bab-dummagansurmalad, unnila suar-sobarmaladid, degi, akwa-sobarmaladid. Ar we-ibmar dulemar sobsamaladid. A-ulale, bela obelosgusmalad.
Emigindi, Bab-Jehová-anmar-Bab-Dummad, we-dulegi wis be anmar-bendake, adi, dulemar bela we-napneggi be-wisgumalaga, unnila bebi Bab-Jehová wargwenna Bab-Dummadga maiye.”
Rey-Senaquerib-burgwisad
Geb degi, Amoz-machi-Isaías, Ezequíasʼse weyob gayaburba barmisad: “Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad weyob soged: ‘Be anga Asiria-e-rey-Senaqueribʼgi, ibmar sogsadi, bela an be-itosye.’
Bab-Jehová weyob Rey-Senaqueribʼnik sogsad:

content.text: Degi, e-baryawarmar yeerdaklegwismaladi an bela immisye.
Degine, e-sapi-dummagan-bukwadi, ei an bela wisgusbarye.

content: ”Bab-Jehová weyob Rey-Senaqueribʼnik sogbalid:

content.text: E-dulemar geg gue-itogedba, sikirmakdemalad, sulibinsa itodmalad.
Sanagwadse be dognonidabali, an nue wisid.
Degine, be angi isdar-sunmaksadi, bela an nue wisid.
be angi apor-sunmaksadi an bela itosad.
Degisoggu, igi moli-bebe-nikamaladga, e-asugi esgoro-wardummad yolege,

content: Isaías, Ezequíasʼga sogdebalid: “We-ibmarmar bega e-wilubga guoed:

content.text: Geb birgapaasedina, be ibmar-gwag digmaloed, degi, weemarbaloed.
Uva be digmaloed, degi, e-sanmakoedi be gunmaloed.

content: ”Deginbali, Bab-Jehová, Asiria-e-reynik weyob soged:

content.text: An we-neggweburgi nue-binsasoggu, degi, an-mai-Davidʼgi na binsabalidgine, we-neggwebur-irwa an gwisguoed,

content: A-mutikidgine, Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur, Asiria-sorda-bukwadgine, mili-dulabaabakebak-gakatar (185,000) dulemar-ogilosad. Degine, neg-oiboargu, Asiria-sordamar burgwar-burgwar-mamai daklealid.
Degidgine, Asiria-sordamar-e-rey-Senaquerib nadegusad. Geb agi, gannar Nínive-neggweburse nonigusad, agine megidapid.

Ibagwengi, Rey-Senaquerib, bab-dummad-Nisrocʼse-goled-neggi e-bab-dummadse gorsiidgi, e-machimala-Adramelec, degi, Sarezer, es-suidgi e-bab-oburgwismalad. Geb Ararat-yalaganse wakite gusmalad. A-sorbali, e-machi-Esar-Hadón yar sesad.
